biotools.summary: DANCE is a software platform for automated and interpretable preprocessing of single-cell data. It leverages two modules: Method-Aware Preprocessing (MAP) and Dataset-Aware Preprocessing (DAP) to discover and recommend optimal pipelines for various tasks, improving reproducibility and providing insights into preprocessing patterns.
